summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end testing of the theme switching feature (7 design directions + ANELEC Original light/dark). All core functionality validated: admin company default theme setting, personal user theme picker, persistence across sessions, and UI integration.
passed_tests: Login with demo@suivi-tce.fr / demo1234 succeeds and loads dashboard
Navigation to 'Utilisateurs et accès' > 'Apparence & Thèmes' tab works
All 7 theme cards render with correct data-testids (theme-card-light, theme-card-dark, theme-card-atlas, theme-card-craft, theme-card-signal, theme-card-swiss, theme-card-bento)
Clicking 'Atlas Clarity' theme card sets html[data-theme]='atlas' immediately
Success toast appears after theme change: 'Apparence « Atlas Clarity » définie comme défaut de l'entreprise.'
Theme card shows 'Défaut entreprise' badge after selection
Allow user override toggle (data-testid='theme-allow-override-toggle') switches on/off without errors
Profile modal (data-testid='profile-menu-modal') contains personal theme picker with 7 cards
Personal theme cards have correct data-testids (theme-personal-light, theme-personal-signal, etc.)
Clicking personal theme card (theme-personal-signal) sets html[data-theme]='signal' live
Reset button (data-testid='theme-reset-user') reverts to company default theme
Theme persistence: setting company default to 'craft', logout, login → theme is 'craft' (persisted in DB)
No critical console errors during theme switching flows
ThemeProvider is single source of truth (Layout.tsx no longer overrides data-theme)
